meta.title: Clay Table | Beginner hand-building pottery, £45
meta.description: A two-hour hand-building pottery session for beginners at £45. Get to know the clay, form a simple vessel, choose a finish. Demo site.

rationale: Дизайн строится на холодной бумажной палитре и кобальтовом акценте из льна на фото: фото трёх белых сосудов ведёт главный экран, цена £45 и три части занятия идут сразу за ним, а кнопка в шапке и в первом экране ведёт к деталям занятия. Visual plan: единственное одобренное фото используется один раз, крупно, справа от заголовка (кадр 3:2, предметы и фактура в центре), дальше работают шрифт, сплошное кобальтовое поле и список без карточек, а групповое занятие подано как обсуждаемая возможность без цены и дат.

props.headline: Shape a vessel with your hands
props.sub: A two-hour hand-building session for beginners, £45. Start with a lump of clay and finish with a simple vessel and a surface you chose.

photo.subject: Three off-white hand-built ceramic pieces, a bowl, a vase and a handled cup, on a cool grey surface with cobalt blue linen. An illustrative sample of the workshop's objects.

featured.name: Beginner hand-building session
featured.description: Hand-building means shaping clay with your hands and simple tools. The session is made for first-timers, so you need no experience and nothing to bring. You work at your own pace on one simple vessel.

others.name: Private group session
others.description: Coming together with friends or colleagues? A private session can be discussed. Price and dates are not set yet.

steps.name: Get to know the clay
steps.detail: Feel how it presses, stretches and holds a shape before you make anything.

steps.name: Form a simple vessel
steps.detail: Build your piece by hand, pinching and smoothing it towards a bowl, cup or small vase.

steps.name: Choose a finish
steps.detail: Decide how the surface should look and feel, from soft and matt to something glossier.

props.before: Pinch, press, smooth: your hands make
